verdict.rationale: Vapi documents dynamic variables in system prompts and messages using double curly braces, plus a dedicated Personalization feature for customer-specific information. Transient (inline) configurations also suggest per-call customization. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the call-time injection mechanism (e.g., how variable values are passed when starting a call), detail on per-caller context sourcing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject dynamic variables and per-caller context at call time so each conversation is personalized

citations.quote: Use dynamic variables in the system prompt or any message in the dashboard with double curly braces
Personalization lets you include customer-specific information in your voice assistant conversations.
Choose between transient (inline) and permanent (stored) configurations to optimize your Vapi implementation
